jobs.name: LogoTideA
jobs.prompt: Edit the attached game logo. Keep the top line "APEX" exactly as it is: the same chunky angular 3D letters, faceted bevels, thick dark navy outline, white fading to aqua, the shark-tooth points and the grey shark fin through the top of the A. Replace the second line with the word "TIDE" (spelled T-I-D-E, four letters) in exactly the same lettering style, size, bevel and navy outline, deep ocean blue fading to glowing teal at the bottom, with a white foam wave crest curling over the top edge of the letters and a few small bubbles rising off it. The logo reads exactly "APEX TIDE" and nothing else. Two stacked lines, centered, generous margins, on the same completely flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) background with no shadows, gradients, scenery or other objects.
